citations.quote: State Assemblymember Catherine Stefani, Sheriff Paul Miyamoto, the advocacy groups GrowSF and AbundantSF, the firefighters union, and more all withdrew their endorsements.
We endorsed Manny Yekutiel earlier this year, but we withdrew our endorsement after three credible sexual assault allegations, which he denies.
